aiVerification.summary: The workbook supports a rubber-material comparison, but the draft has parsing and outcome-grouping errors that must be corrected.
issues: Changed factor domain is left unknown despite rubber material evidence.
Measurement-2 is a misparsed function header/defect breakdown, not a separate measurement outcome.
Tension rows appear to have multiple sample values but sampleCount is set to 1.
Tension spec/result fields are inconsistently parsed and condition text includes result labels.
Some cited rows are not shown in context, limiting full value verification.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to rubber material/type comparison: normal LSR vs high-temp rubber vs EPDM 65A.
Remove measurement-2 or fold defect categories into the function defect outcome only if row values support them.
Reparse tension rows 27-29 with correct spec, pass result, sample values, min, max, and avg.
Keep function and tension outcomes under the same validation report context.
Use only rows with actual condition/result data plus title/purpose rows as evidence.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are sufficient for the main comparison after fixing/removing the header-derived outcome.
